notes.title: Ao Norte's new game, Die or Die!, has a demo: check it out here!
notes.content: [p]Hello, fellow gardeners![/p][p][/p][p]Ever since the release of Tiny Garden, [b]we have been working on a new project at Ao Norte[/b]. Something completely different from this cozy, gardening game. [b]Die or Die! is a top-down roguelite shooter with dice management elements[/b] and we’re happy to announce that [b]its demo is now available[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]In Die or Die, luck and skill are equally important. Before every level, you roll a set of dice, and based on the outcome, you decide how the level will unfold. You can [b]spend your dice to deactivate “bummers”[/b], handicaps that make levels incrementally harder, [b]or to acquire new skills and weapons[/b] that would make survival easier. [/p][p][/p][p]Let us show an example, which should give you a clearer picture. Before each level, bummers will appear exponentially (first 1, then 2, 3 and so on) and you need to meet certain conditions to deactivate them: get a fixed value (let’s say, a 5) or a higher number meaning you have to expend more than one dice. Sometimes you will be able to deactivate all the bummers. Others, you will have to choose between the lesser evil. Luckily for you, you can also get weapons and skills that will help you through the level.[/p][p][/p][p]What do bummers look like?[/p][list][*][p]Bigger, stronger enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Inverted controls[/p][/*][*][p]Invisible HUD[/p][/*][*][p]Shooting crazy (and inoffensive) chickens[/p][/*][*][p]A grim reaper that follows you. RUN![/p][/*][*][p]Dead enemies that come back as ghosts to slow you down[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters chasing you because an overexcited fan won’t stop following you[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You get the idea. It’s not going to be a walk in the park.[/p][p][/p][p]On the other hand, you might equip yourself with bigger, meaner weapons, ignite enemies just by touching them, or summon a pair of heavily armed twins to fight at your side. How you survive each level is up to you.[/p][p][/p][p]We're [b]releasing the demo[/b] right now but this is just the beginning. We will be [b]joining the Steam Next Fest[/b] (October 13-20) and our roadmap includes an Early Access release. We will share more details soon, but for now, let’s just say we want your feedback before we ship the final game. Now is the best moment to start playing Die or Die. Just remember, luck won't always be on your side, so prepare to die. A lot.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842190/Die_or_Die/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Tiny Garden Patch Notes V1.0.5 👷‍♂️🌻
notes.content:
Hello Tiny Gardeners! 

We've had a very exciting launch week with so much love pouring out from our community. We've listened to feedback and identified the biggest issues in the current build, and we feel confident that we've fixed them. Here are the latest patch notes 👇

[h1]Tiny Garden V1.0.5 💖 [/h1] [list]
[*] Improved VRAM usage through resource indirection and texture compression (basis universal).
[*] Greatly improved VRAM usage through resource indirection and texture compression (basis universal).
[*] Fixed korean delete_data string.
[*] Added generic tree icon to climbers catalog cards
[*] Enlarged seeder sign icons.
[*] Fixed bug where previous compost tiles were incrementing the Steam stat when loading a game. [/list]

A few players have experienced and issue which stopped them from opening the game. We've managed to figure out a fix for this. However, if you open the game and are still experiencing issues, please follow the below steps 👇

[h3]Toggle Steam Cloud Off[/h3] [olist]
[*] In your Steam library, highlight Tiny Garden
[*] Right click Tiny Garden and select [Properties]
[*] In the General tab, toggle OFF the Steam Cloud setting (see screenshot) [/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/6d31a28c1e008536a2b0e36b77b07ca51b208138.png[/img]

[h3]Accessing the AppData[/h3]
[i]To access the AppData folder, please following the below instructions.[/i] [olist]
[*] Open File Explorer
[*] Select the 'View' tab
[*] Tick the 'Hidden Items' box [/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/6713a048c082b4b8308ebbba197a2b20d60c7572.png[/img]

[h3]Deleting the Tiny Garden folder[/h3]
[i]Note: The YOURNAME part is entirely depending on your system/names[/i] [olist]
[*] Follow the path: C:\Users\YOURNAME\AppData\Roaming [list]
[*] Select the C drive
[*] Select Users
[*] Select YOURNAME (depending on your login)
[*] Select AppData
[*] Select Roaming [/list] [*] Delete the 'Tiny Garden' folder
[*] Try launching the game. [/olist]

If you are still experiencing a crash after taking these steps, then the issue is likely seperate to the bug that other's are experiencing. At which point, you should [url=https://discord.gg/QyAn3E7WcR]join our discord server[/url] and send over your game logs so that we can help you further!

Thank you again for all of the support you've given us over the launch period. Please leave a review for the game if you're having a good time as that helps us a lot!

- Ao Norte and Super Rare Originals 💙

notes.title: Tiny Garden Update and Roadmap 👷‍♂️🥕
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday Tiny Gardeners! 🥕

It's officially been 24 hours since we've launched and we're so excited by all the wonderful feedback and love that our community has given back to us 

[h3]Launch Hotfix ⚒️[/h3]
We plan to release a quick hotfix today addressing some easy to fix issues within Tiny Garden. These include things like the achievement bug and a cursor bug. Also some minor visual improvements and more.

[h3]Crash Bug 👷‍♂️[/h3]
An issue that some players have come across a bug that crashes the game when it's first opened. We, unfortunately, were not able to find this bug while testing the game. After investigating, it seems like it is an issue with the engine and will take a little longer to fix it. In the mean time, here are some fixes that we believe might help: [list]
[*] Double check your system meets the minimum specs on the Steam store page.
[*] Verify your game files. Right click the game in Steam library -> Select Properties -> Select Installed Files tab -> Select [Verify Integrity of game files]
[*] Uninstall the game and redownload it.
[*] For some people, it might be a case of making sure they meet the minimum specs on the systems they're playing on as some of the logs indicate they are under spec.
[*] For anyone playing on laptops with dual graphics cards, try switching from the integrated graphics card (if it defaults to that) to the dedicated graphics card. 
Note: The laptop power mode may impact this, so check this setting to prioritise performance [/list]
If none of these working, then you will have to wait until we sort out the fix. We're so sorry that this has come up. It is our top priority to fix it.

[h3]Exciting Discord Extras 📣[/h3]
To celebrate passing 600 discord members, we've decided to start holding discord community polls to help us add more and more cool content to Tiny Garden over time. Be sure to join our discord to vote in these, get the latest updates on patches and report bugs directly to us.

[b]Join our discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/QyAn3E7WcR]https://discord.gg/QyAn3E7WcR[/url][/b]

[h3]Summer Breeze Content Update 😎☀️[/h3]
Something super exciting to look forward too in the future is the Summer Breeze content update! With new seeds and gameplay options coming. As the weather gets warmer, there's even more to discover!

Thank you for all of your support during this launch period!

- Ao Norte & Super Rare Originals 💙

notes.title: Tiny Garden Demo is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey there gardeners!

We have exciting news! We have already surpassed 1500 backers in[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aonorte/tiny-garden-build-your-own-magical-garden-inside-a-90s-toy] our Kickstarter campaign[/url]. We can thank all of the backers for their support, we couldn't make it without them!

We want to give you all something special in return, so today we’re releasing the Tiny Garden Demo you might have seen some content creators playing. This is a very tiny demo, it will take you just 20 minutes of playing at max, but we believe it showcases well the possibilities behind Tiny Garden’s ideas. The demo will be only available during the Kickstarter campaign, until August 2nd.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2812450/Tiny_Garden/

In this demo, you will discover different vegetables and plants that will change the terrain. Also a fountain and five pieces of furniture to decorate the top part of the toy. Bear in mind that this is just a prototype focused on the core mechanics, meaning that many visual and design elements, as well as accessibility and control options, are not finished. 

That means, for example, that the furniture doesn’t have any mechanics apart from customizing the house space in a very simple fashion. The final version of Tiny Garden will have many more customization and personal expression options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/7d4b80d21326e333322fe5334400405e93117a08.jpg[/img]

As I said, this is just a tiny proof-of-concept for the game, but I’m sure you’ll love it!

Please, share with us any feedback you might have or just the joy of playing our demo. You can share whatever you want from the demo on Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, or any socials, that would help us a lot!

See you in the tiny garden!

notes.title: Tiny Garden - Making Of
notes.content:
Hey there gardeners!

You might already know that[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aonorte/tiny-garden-build-your-own-magical-garden-inside-a-90s-toy] we're doing a Kickstarter campaign[/url], which is very stressful! But we're actually enjoying it and it's going pretty pretty pretty well! Thank you very much to all our backers for keep supporting the campaign!!!

We want to show you a peek behind the curtain. We started with Tiny Garden in September 2023 and, barely three months after, we already had a prototype for the game. Bear in mind that we had other jobs, so we did all that (and keep doing It) during our spare time.

At first, the game looked like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/edd3731cdcc01e45c6fb4b7580ac646a1213e3a3.png[/img]

But the ideas were already there! You could take a pepper, put it on the ground, turn an invisible crank and the pepper will pop out of the soil. That's the core of the game!

Even our very early sketches and rough visual ideas didn't look like the final toy:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/32dd392b38d78dcf05e12328af8cee3eca5c5bb9.jpg[/img]

But, at least, our vegetables, plants, fountain, and even the types of soil did look like the ones we have now in the game (you can also see the cursor as hand):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/d41786e2f42d2f12865f19c7db864d608e7a040e.jpg[/img]

To be honest, before all of that, we had a first iteration with a very schematic representation to visualize how this game would end up looking. We showed the following images to different friends and they loved the initial idea so that pushed us into making the prototype!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/cff45aad6746ae41bc77b1408d296c107017abe4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/4aeabbb1d62a26f4a4e5f2be9ee9e629ff64c862.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the toy would be much simpler, more like a rectangle, with fewer squares on the grid and spots to place your pieces of furniture. 

So What do you think about these images of the process behind Tiny Garden?

It's been a long journey, but we believe it's paying off. We can't wait to show you more about our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037249/247b170b9330d487e604523eb7d88a69d61904ae.jpg[/img]

See you in the Tiny Garden!
